share.title: Save from your phone
share.android: On Android, install Tabooki (browser menu → Add to Home screen). It then shows up in the Share menu of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or the browser.
share.iphoneIntro: iPhones don't let web apps appear in the Share menu, so this uses a shortcut in the Shortcuts app. Create a key for your iPhone and follow the steps.
share.copyNow: Copy the key now: it won't be shown again. It can only save links, and you can revoke it here.

steps.open: On the iPhone, open Shortcuts and create a new shortcut with +.
steps.shareSheet: Tap ⓘ and turn on Show in Share Sheet. Under Receive, keep only URLs and Text.
steps.getContents: Add the Get Contents of URL action with the address above and, under Show More, the method POST.
steps.headers: Under Headers, add Authorization with the value above (it starts with Bearer).
steps.body: Under Request Body, choose JSON and add the field url with the Shortcut Input variable.
steps.notify: Add Get Dictionary Value for the key message, then Show Notification with that value.
steps.name: Name it Save to Tabooki. To use it: Share → Save to Tabooki.
